description: This file defines FastAPI routes for managing user sessions, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting sessions, and posting messages within sessions. It interacts with a Supabase backend and enforces user ownership and access controls.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client instance using environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the current user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session along with its messages, ensuring user ownership.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update session details.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a session.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Submits a message for a session, including initial user message and assistant stub, enforcing session ownership and file presence.
